name: System Availability And Events 3
definition: Specifies the details about the system availability and the related system events that might impact the availability.

SystemCurrency.name: System Currency
SystemCurrency.definition: Currency which may be processed by the system. A system may process transactions in a single currency or in multiple currencies.

Event.name: Event
Event.definition: Detailed information about an event occurring on a system, whether planned, such as the cut-off time for a specific type of eligible transfer, or unplanned (an unsolicited failure), as stipulated in the specifications of the system.

ClosureInformation.name: Closure Information
ClosureInformation.definition: Information regarding the closure time of a system.
